description: This Java class 'EmailConfigurationValidator' handles validation of email configuration JSON data, including checking required fields, length constraints, and email format validation within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationValidator
classes.description: A final class responsible for validating email configuration JSON data, including email format validation.

methods.name: validateUpdateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the provided JSON string for updating email configuration, checking required fields and constraints.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if there are any validation errors collected.

methods.name: isValidEmail
methods.description: Checks if the provided email string matches the email pattern and basic validity rules.
